definition: Waste-shipment profile: notification, consent and control requirements for transboundary movements of waste (Basel Convention; EU shipments framework)

custody.note: the consignment is the custody unit (R7 membership node); identity is preserved through the movement

manifest.issuing_role: notifier (waste holder, producer or facility of origin); competent-authority consents enter as stamps

legal_basis.citation: prior informed consent; Annexes I–IX listings
legal_basis.instrument: Basel Convention on the Control of Transboundary Movements of Hazardous Wastes and Their Disposal
Regulation (EC) No 1013/2006 on shipments of waste (as in force until 2026-05-20)

legal_basis.citation: notification, consent, digitalised procedures and inspection requirements
legal_basis.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2024/1157 on shipments of waste (applies from 2026-05-21)
OECD Council Decision on the control of transboundary movements of wastes destined for recovery operations

manifest.notes: The movement is an event on the waste-side passport chain, never a document parallel to it: the notification and consent references ride the custody event, so the border authority's verification (Tier-A offline minimum with pinned anchors) and the end-of-waste assessor's later reconstruction read the same record. The 2026-05-21 effective_from tracks Regulation (EU) 2024/1157's application date; the supersession of the 1013/2006 legal-basis entry is expressed by force class, not by rewriting the profile.

transforms.method_citation: Basel Annexes to EU List of Waste correspondence

triggers.description: subject in waste status enters a cross-border movement event (custody.transfer with jurisdiction change; export, import or transit)
